hotspots.name: Central Bank
hotspots.description: Bank deposits open at minute 10. Maximum ₹200. Holding fee: 0.1% per real minute, rounded to the nearest paisa, funds raid prizes. Transit is fee-exempt. Withdrawals take five minutes; 10% remains reserved while a raid is active.

hotspots.name: Race Terminal
hotspots.description: Races open at minutes 30, 90 and 135. The first three correct answers receive ₹50, ₹30 and ₹20 from the race pool.

hotspots.name: Checkout
hotspots.description: Voluntary Checkout opens at minute 150 and permanently seals your score. Transit must arrive first. Raid members and jailed operators cannot check out. Offline recovery retains its ten-minute grace period.

hotspots.name: Leaderboard
hotspots.description: Final ranking uses Home plus Bank, then completed challenges, then the time that balance was reached.

hotspots.name: Raid Circle
hotspots.description: Crews need 8 operators if fewer than 36 are registered at event start; otherwise 10. Hold the circle for 60 seconds after five completions. Each operator gets five private questions, two clears pass the gate, and five passing operators make the raid succeed.

hotspots.name: Tech Job Board

First-year Code, Debug, CTF and Puzzle contracts. Starter ₹10, Standard ₹20, Expert ₹80; training pays ₹0. All tasks and workbenches stay inside the game.

hotspots.name: Undercity Information
hotspots.description: Each operator owns one Home. Earnings arrive there first and can be exposed to burglary. Burglary requires a server-held lock and a validated challenge.

hotspots.name: Local Market
hotspots.description: Homes and burglary are governed by the event rules. There is no direct player-to-player money transfer.

hotspots.name: NEXUS Announcements
hotspots.description: NEXUS announces waves, races, bounties and Golden Hour clues. The default event lasts 180 minutes.

hotspots.name: Social Hub
hotspots.description: A public gathering place. The game does not permit direct money transfers between operators.

hotspots.name: Golden Hour Terminal
hotspots.description: Card Hunt at minute 70, Courier Chase at 115 and Server Sprint at 165 each use a fixed ₹100 pool.

hotspots.name: Event Terminal
hotspots.description: Golden Hour start points and clues are announced by NEXUS; the server controls event availability.

hotspots.name: NEXUS Information
hotspots.description: City announcements and event rules are available here. Every operator starts with zero wealth.
